senses.gloss:
जप् जप् (a form of जल्प्), i. 1, Par. (also Ātm., MBh. 13, 750).
 1. To speak low, to murmur (prayers), Man. 2, 78.
 2. To pray to in a low voice, MBh. 13, 750. []
 3. To invoke murmuring, Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 29.
 --Ptcple. of the future pass. जप्य and जाप्य, n. A low prayer, Man. 2, 87; Bhāg. P. 8, 3, 1.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To pray low afterwards, Bhāg. P. 5, 18, 29.
 --With अभि अभि, To charm, Rām. 2, 25, 36.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To whisper to, Rām. 1, 9, 38.
 2. To bring over to one's party, Man. 7, 197.
 --With प्र प्र, To recite in a low tone, MBh. 3, 13432.
 --With सम् सम्, To report, MBh. 4, 111.

जप जप् + अ, m.
 1. Muttering prayers, Man. 3, 74.
 2. A prayer, Rām. 1, 25, 3.
जपा जपा, f. The China rose, Kir. 5, 8; Śiś. 9, 8.

जाप जाप, i. e. जप् + अ, m. A prayer, Rām. 1, 31, 31.
 --Comp.
जपन जप् + अन, n. Muttering prayers, MBh. 12, 7157.
जपिन् जप् + इन्, adj. Muttering prayers, Yājñ. 3, 286.
जापिन् जापिन्, i. e. जप् + इन्, adj. Reciting in a low tone, Yājñ. 3, 304.

जापक जापक, i. e. जप् + अक, adj.
 1. Muttering prayers, MBh. 12, 7153.
 2. Produced by prayer, MBh. 12, 7249.
जप- + यज्ञ जप- + यज्ञ, murmuring prayers, Man. 2, 85.
जप- + होम जप- + होम, m. the oblation consisting in prayers, Man. 10, 111.
